fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕冲突、受不了夹心、情绪化的人。这行天天在资方和劳方之间，里外不是人是常态。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：人力资源/劳动法相关专业 → 进企业 HR 或工会做助理 → 跟谈判与争议处理 → 独立管劳动关系 → 转 HR 经理或劳动关系顾问。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合沟通强、懂劳动法、情绪稳、能在冲突里找共识的人。你愿意两头磨也能扛住压力，这行就是你的。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你享受「把僵局谈活」的成就感，又坐得住谈判桌，这行会让你有存在感。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not replacement, but increasing technological assistance. Systems absorb recordkeeping and monitoring, while core professionals who can decide and perform procedures are more secure.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It is a poor fit for people who fear responsibility or blood, resist learning, or cannot tolerate high-pressure shifts. These roles require credentials and accountability, which are difficult without endurance.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: bachelor's degree in nursing, standardized training, specialty training, practice as a Nurse Practitioner, nurse-midwife, or nurse anesthetist, then advanced practice or clinical teaching.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits strong, steady caregivers who can study continuously and are willing to take responsibility for outcomes. If responsibility to patients is your standard, this field offers stability.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are a strong, steady caregiver who treats responsibility to patients as the standard, specialty nursing is one of the most consequential high-barrier healthcare paths.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕责任、怕血、学不进、受不了高压轮班的人。这类岗位要持证也要扛责，耐不住会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：护理本科 → 规培 → 专科培训 → 执业护士 / 助产 / 麻醉 → 高级实践或带教。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合照护强、稳、能长期学习、愿意对结果负责的人。你愿意把「对病人负责」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你照护强、稳、把「对病人负责」当标准，专科护理是高门槛最有分量的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but psychological exhaustion. You must care for yourself before you can care well for patients.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit emotionally sensitive people, those unable to tolerate unfair treatment, or those afraid of risk. The work can involve verbal abuse or even assault and has a high psychological threshold.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: nursing, mental health, or psychology education → psychiatric ward internship → nursing qualification or mental health certification → begin with daily living support → advance toward psychiatric nursing, psychotherapy, or rehabilitation management.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits emotionally steady, patient people who genuinely want to help. If you can remain calm during a patient's emotional storm, the field needs you.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you accept high pressure and modest expected rewards but understand the weight of a patient's thank you, this career is worth continuing.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Emotional stability: you are the anchor in the ward's storms
Patience: recovery is slow and cannot be rushed
Empathy: understand what patients leave unsaid
Observation: changes in condition do not escape you
Resilience: withstand shifts, risks, and unfair treatment

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合情绪敏感、受不了委屈、怕风险的人。这行可能面对辱骂甚至攻击，心理门槛很高。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：护理、精神卫生或心理相关专业 → 进精神科病房实习 → 考护士资格或精神卫生相关证书 → 从生活照护做起 → 向精神科护理、心理治疗师或康复管理方向走。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合情绪稳定、有耐心、真心想帮人的人。你要是能在患者的情绪风暴里保持平静，这行很需要你。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受「高压力、低回报预期，但患者那句『谢谢你』的分量」，这行值得坚持。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 情绪稳定：病房的风浪里，你是锚
耐心：恢复是慢的，急不来
同理心：听得懂患者没说出口的话
观察力：状态变化逃不过你的眼
抗压：轮班、风险、委屈都要接住

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but changing regulations + heavy responsibility. The role sits at a critical point while tolerance for error declines.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people who fear change or cannot handle cross-time-zone pressure. Regulations change frequently, deadlines are tight, and managers face accountability first when problems occur. People who cannot remain focused or only want individual work will struggle.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study pharmacy, biology, law, or a related field; work as an RA specialist; earn RAC; advance to senior specialist; and move into RA manager or director roles.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits logical people who study regulatory language closely and can lead teams and accept responsibility. If the right pathway, steady pace, and compliance are your baseline, you can thrive in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you understand regulations, lead people, and accept accountability, RA manager is one of the most needed management roles in pharmaceuticals.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕变动、扛不住跨时区高压的人。法规常改、deadline 紧、出了事首当其冲，坐不住或只愿单干的人会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径：药学/生物/法律相关 → 做 RA 专员 → 考 RAC → 升资深 → 转 RA 经理/总监。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合逻辑强、爱抠条文、又能带队伍扛责任的人。你把「路径对、节奏稳、合规」当底线，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你既读得懂法、又带得动人、还扛得起责，RA 经理是医药圈最被需要的管理岗。

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but CNC plus prefabrication. Factories absorb standard slabs, while people skilled in irregular shapes and restoration become more secure.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This occupation does not suit people who dislike dirt and physical work, cannot tolerate repetitive grinding, or retreat from dust. Stonemasons frequently crouch, reach overhead, and work outdoors, making rushed work especially difficult.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is to begin through an apprenticeship or vocational school, work as a stonemason helper, build masonry independently, take responsibility for irregular shapes and restoration, and become a foreperson or open a stone workshop.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits people with steady hands who can tolerate hardship, read drawings, and handle outdoor work. If you treat aligned stone joints as your professional standard, you can thrive in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you have steady hands, can tolerate hardship, and treat aligned stone joints as your professional standard, stonemasonry is one of the most craftsmanship-intensive entry points into construction.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
